guidance: Close a browser tab opened for you, once you are done with it (for example when a test or check is finished and its data is exported): a page dsagent.page.open opened, a page a guided wizard you drive opened (the sample detail page it reported as pagePick.pageContextId), or any tab of a named browser session (sessionGroup new or previous). These stay closable after an Extension reload, so close leftovers from earlier tasks too. Only those pages can be closed: the person's own tabs, a workflow run's tabs and any other tab are refused with POLICY_DENIED, and a page a guided wizard or a workflow run is still using is refused with TARGET_BUSY until it finishes or is canceled. A page that is already gone succeeds with alreadyClosed true. The page context is released after closing. Requires an idempotency key; repeating a key returns the first result.

pageContextId.description: The pageContextId dsagent.page.open returned or a guided wizard reported as pagePick.pageContextId for a page it opened (or the one dsagent.pages.list lists for that same tab).
The page context that was closed; dsagent.page.* no longer accepts it.

closed.description: Always true: the tab is gone.

alreadyClosed.description: True when the tab was already gone (closed by the person or the browser) before this call.
